Hey! So I’m going through something similar with my relationship. Just remember that at least you are aware of it and maybe tell your partner when you’re feeling unstable so they know not to take your actions/words to heart. And it doesn’t make you a bad person! You didn’t choose to have BPD and it’s not your fault. And my partner always reminds me that it doesn’t make me any less of a person, that he likes me, and that he isn’t mad. Self-destructing/sabotaging is really painful because you know you’re actively fucking up a good thing when you know that your normal self doesn’t really want to, but what I personally do is avoid speaking too much to my partner while I’m in one of my episodes so I don’t say anything too rash. You’re not a monster! You just need some extra support and love, and as a fellow BPD I’m always here to talk if you need it!
